rows.ja: 仕入先(Walmartでの販売を記載)
AI・金融・投資の提携先

relations.text: Rokuの製品は、Walmartなどの小売店を通じて販売される
relations.text_en: Roku's products are sold through retailers such as Walmart.

source.label: Roku 10-K
source.quote: In the United States, the majority of our products and our licensed Roku TV partners’ products are sold through brick and mortar retailers, such as Best Buy, Target, and Walmart, including their online sales platforms, and online retailers such as Amazon, and to a lesser extent our website (excluding Roku TV models).

relations.text: WalmartはOnn.ブランドの配信機器を製造・販売し、Rokuと競合する
relations.text_en: Walmart competes with Roku, making and selling Onn. branded streaming products

source.label: Roku 10-K
source.quote: We also face increased competition from Walmart (which makes and sells Onn. branded streaming products, including co-branded Roku TV models), in light of its acquisition of Vizio (which makes and sells smart TVs with

companies.name: コンステレーション・エナジー

relations.text: ConstellationとWalmartが、イリノイ州のDresden原子力発電所からの無排出電力について、長期の電力購入契約を発表した
relations.text_en: Constellation and Walmart announced a long-term nuclear power purchase agreement for emissions-free electricity from Constellation's Dresden Clean Energy Center in Illinois

source.label: Walmart の発表
source.quote: Constellation (Nasdaq: CEG) and Walmart (Nasdaq: WMT) today announced a long-term nuclear power purchase agreement (PPA) for emissions-free electricity from Constellation’s Dresden Clean Energy Center in Illinois.

companies.name: エイブリィ・デニソン

relations.text: WalmartとAvery Dennisonが、生鮮食品向けのRFID技術を前進させる新たな取り組みを発表した
relations.text_en: Walmart and Avery Dennison announced a new innovation to advance the use of RFID technology in fresh categories

source.label: Walmart の発表
source.quote: Walmart (NYSE: WMT) and Avery Dennison (NYSE: AVY) today announced a new innovation to advance the use of radio-frequency identification (RFID) technology in fresh categories previously not possible.

relations.text: SymboticがWalmartのAdvanced Systems and Robotics事業の買収に合意したと発表した
relations.text_en: Symbotic announced it agreed to acquire the Advanced Systems and Robotics business from Walmart

source.label: Symbotic の発表
source.quote: Symbotic Inc. (Nasdaq: SYM), a leader in A.I.-enabled robotics technology for the supply chain, today announced it has agreed to acquire the Advanced Systems and Robotics business from Walmart (NYSE: WMT).

relations.text: Symboticは2017年以降、Walmartのサプライチェーンの自動化を支えてきた
relations.text_en: Symbotic has played a critical role in enabling Walmart to automate its supply chain since 2017

source.label: Symbotic の発表
source.quote: Symbotic has played a critical role in enabling Walmart to automate its vast supply chain since 2017

relations.text: Walmartは、店舗でのオンライン受け取り・配送向けの先進的な仕組みの開発・構築・導入をSymboticに任せた
relations.text_en: Walmart chose Symbotic to develop, build and deploy an advanced solution for online pickup and delivery options at stores

source.label: Symbotic の発表
source.quote: Walmart has chosen Symbotic to develop, build and deploy an advanced solution leveraging Symbotic’s A.I.-enabled robotics platform to offer Walmart customers greater shopping convenience through accelerated online pickup and delivery options at stores.

relations.text: Walmartは5年契約で、Microsoft AzureとMicrosoft 365を含むMicrosoftのクラウド製品群を選んだ
relations.text_en: In a five-year agreement, Walmart selected the full range of Microsoft cloud solutions, including Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365

source.label: Walmart の発表
source.quote: In a five-year agreement, Walmart has selected the full range of Microsoft cloud solutions, including Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 for enterprise-wide use to help standardize across the company’s family of brands.

relations.text: OnePayとSynchronyが、Walmart向けの新しいクレジットカードプログラムを共同で提供する戦略的提携を発表した
relations.text_en: OnePay and Synchrony announced a strategic partnership to exclusively power a new credit card program with Walmart

source.label: Synchrony の発表
source.quote: OnePay, a leading consumer fintech, and Synchrony (NYSE: SYF), a premier consumer financial services company, today announced a strategic partnership to exclusively power a new industry-leading credit card program with Walmart (NYSE: WMT).

relations.text: WalmartはGoogleと組み、Walmartの買い物体験をGeminiアプリ内に提供する
relations.text_en: Walmart is partnering with Google to bring the Walmart experience directly into Gemini

source.label: WMT / Alphabet — primary relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.label_en: WMT / Alphabet — primary relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.quote: Partnering with Google to bring the Walmart experience directly into Gemini is another step toward creating seamless shopping experiences for customers and members that are more intuitive and personal than ever before."

relations.text: WalmartとOpenAIの新たな提携により、顧客はChatGPTで買い物ができるようになる
relations.text_en: Walmart's new partnership with OpenAI will allow customers and members to shop with ChatGPT

source.label: WMT / Alphabet — primary relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.label_en: WMT / Alphabet — primary relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.quote: Walmart’s new partnership with OpenAI will allow customers and members to shop with ChatGPT, creating an AI-first experience where shoppers can simply chat and select.

relations.text: Walmartは、JD.comへの投資の売却で36億ドルの純収入を得た
relations.text_en: Walmart received $3.6 billion in net proceeds from the sale of its JD.com investment

source.label: Walmart 10-K
source.quote: consideration of $1.9 billion, partially offset by net proceeds received from sales of certain strategic investments, including $3.6 billion related to the sale of our JD.com investment.

source.label: Costco 10-K
source.quote: Walmart, Target, Kroger, and Amazon are among our significant general merchandise retail competitors in the U.S.
